name: WebSocket
description: A WebSocket client connection to an external server.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The WebSocket URL, for example ws://localhost:8080

functions.name: Send
functions.description: Sends a text message, returns false if the connection is not open

functions.name: Close
functions.description: Closes the connection and destroys the WebSocket

events.name: ReceiveMessage
events.description: Triggered when a text message was received

events.name: Close
events.description: Triggered when the connection was closed
